messages:
carmen: spotted a morning spike of fncall validation errors from commerce-proxy. console shows red failures but the responses are arrays not objects. product alarmed.
hiro: example from logs: validator: error=invalid_shape details='expected object, got array' sample='[{"id":1,"name":"x"}]'
lev: note we flipped the stricter fncall gate in canary last night. fallback routing to cheaper variant is active.
tara: billing currently charges the model that actually executed (final_model_id). observability increments validation_reject on the origin route, so counts and charge don't match.
carmen: customers see big red error rates and assume dropped requests. but their users received content via fallback.
hiro: two quick proposals: 1) console show a distinct "soft-fallback" (amber) state for validation->fallback flows listing origin_route + execution_model + redacted sample; 2) add telemetry tags so dashboards can join charge vs error.
lev: telemetry idea: emit event.tags = [fallback_reason=(validation|timeout|capacity), origin_route_id, execution_model_id, coercion_applied=(yes|no), counted_for_billing=(yes|no)]. add metric soft_fallback_rate.
tara: policy: introduce per-route knob fncall_shape_policy={strict,soft,coerce}. default enterprise=soft. coerce allows safe adapter wrapping (array -> {items: array}).
hiro: rollout change: exclude soft/coerce events from auto-flip calculations; auto-flip should only consider fatal rejects or capacity failures to avoid surprise traffic moves.
carmen: UX: console popover should show origin vs billed model and a one-line reason. link to billing docs.
lev: metrics: change validation_reject -> validation_event.kind=(hard|soft|coercion) so alerts only fire on hard. add 5%/15m alert on soft_fallback_rate with staged paging.
tara: impl notes: validator must emit machine reason codes + optional suggested_coercion. adapters implement optional coercion path gated by route policy.
carmen: action items: S1 telemetry tags & soft_fallback metric (hiro), S1 console soft-fallback state + sample popover (tara), S2 validator reason codes + suggested_coercion (lev), S2 adapters coercion opt-in (lev), S2 billing wording + FAQ (tara).
ops-bot: deploy 4789450000-fncall-validator-canary -> success (canary)
hiro: I'll open tickets and add schema for the new telemetry tags.
tara: I'll mock the console state and add copy for billing.
lev: I'll prototype a tiny coercion wrapper in adapter for enterprise routes.
carmen: thanks all. if any route hits >10% soft-fallback before changes, post top 3 samples here and ping @eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
